summary: New Cell.RetireWorldIntoPoolForSceneExit: the first half of a cell swap (no suction, no rebuild) that parks a cell's world in EnvironmentPrismPool before its scene unloads. The swap's bookkeeping reset moved into ResetBooksAfterRetire (no behaviour change intended) and ReleaseRetiredWorld takes its slice as a parameter. Used only by the Maelstrom hub so a round re-issues the previewed arena instead of cloning it again.
why: A Maelstrom round laid its arena twice (hub preview, then the round), each a long frame with Relay live; a host freeze there ends the tournament (B45, Docs/Reports/MAELSTROM_MULTIPLAYER_RUNS.md).
